Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry tasks, previously known as Azure Container Registry build, enables inner-loop development in the cloud with on-demand container image builds. Trigger container image builds automatically when code is committed to a Git repository or when a container's base image is updated. With base image update triggers, you can also automate your OS and application framework patching workflow, only available with Azure, to maintain secure environments.  

Learn more from the Azure Container Registry blog.
